title: Share of 2022 global e-waste properly recycled

source.name: Global E-waste Monitor 2024
source.publisher: United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR) / International Telecommunication Union (ITU)

notes: Only 22.3% of the 62 million tonnes of e-waste generated in 2022 was documented as properly collected and recycled; the remainder was dumped, burned, or handled with no formal tracking.
